press.text: The Cheatham Street Music Foundation is pleased to announce the results of its first fundraiser at the Redbird Listening Room in New Braunfels, Texas. This intimate concert featured Susan Gibson, Kyle Reed (of the Reed Brothers), Eric Middleton (of Midnight River Choir), and Dallas Burrow, all performing donated sets. As a result, CSMF raised $2,000 to help fund its ongoing support of Kent Finlay's Songwriters' Circle, The Redbird Songwriters' Night, and other showcases and events.
